question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

An extremely abnormal fear of confined space
solution:
The correct answer is: Claustrophobia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Claustrophobia"** means an extreme or irrational fear of confined spaces.
 
• **"Claustrophobia"** refers to the fear of being in closed or small spaces, which can cause panic attacks and anxiety. (संकीर्ण स्थानों का भय)
 
 
• ​​Example: She couldn't take the elevator due to her **claustrophobia**.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Acrophobia **(ऊँचाई का भय): An extreme or irrational fear of heights.

 
 
• **Example:** His **acrophobia **prevented him from going up the tall building.
 
 
 
• **Glossophobia **(सार्वजनिक बोलने का भय): An extreme or irrational fear of public speaking.
 
 
• **Example:** She avoided presentations due to her **glossophobia**.
 
 
 
• **Selenophobia **(चंद्रमा का भय): An extreme or irrational fear of the moon.
 
 
• **Example:** His **selenophobia **kept him indoors during full moons.
